CustomField.description: DealId|ParticipantType|coalesce(AccountId,ContactId,UserId)|Role. Set while a participant occupies an active slot (Invited through Suspended), cleared to null on Declined/Removed/Superseded/Expired. Not cleared on Suspended - a suspended slot is still "the" active slot for Resume to return to, and a second concurrent invite for the same slot must still be rejected as a duplicate. Unique so concurrent invitations cannot create two active participants for the same deal/ type/actor/role - mirrors Partner_Lead_Assignment__c.Active_Assignment_Key__c.
CustomField.label: Active Participant Key
